title: AI CO-PILOT RECIPE: HOW TO USE POSTERMAKER

sections.title: ⚠️ THE REALITY CHECK
sections.content: AI is blind unless guided. **Always verify:** The agent must read `DESIGN.md` before coding. **The Death Loop:** If the AI keeps breaking the design, stop. Force it to run `impeccable teach` and reload the context.

sections.title: 🗺️ THE BIG PICTURE
sections.content:
**The Global View:** A code-driven factory for generating high-craft, professional posters.
**The Motivation:** Stop tweaking pixels in Figma. Define content in JSON, let the agent apply the `Typst` visual engine.
**Why skip it?** If you just need a basic Google Doc.

sections.title: 🛠️ THE SETUP
sections.content:
**Prerequisites:**
- `typst` CLI installed
- The `data/` and `assets/` folders populated
**Safe Credentials:** No API keys required. It runs 100% locally.
**Accelerants:** Impeccable Design Workflow scripts.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 1: BLUEPRINT
sections.content:
**Desc:** Define content in `data/*.json`. Use `idea/variations.md` for inspiration.
**The Prompt:** *'Draft a Variant A JSON for data analysis.'*
**Expected:** Structured JSON matching the `template.md` schema.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 2: BUILD
sections.content:
**Desc:** Switch data in `main.typ` and tweak `template.typ` if needed.
**The Prompt:** *'Change main.typ to use my new json and adjust the primary color.'*
**Expected:** Local PDF/PNG reflects the new content and style.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 3: AUDIT
sections.content:
**Desc:** Run `typst compile` and check for overflows or font warnings.
**Manual Check:** Does the tracking (-0.9pt) make the title look academic?
**Guardrails:** Fix 'unknown font' warnings before shipping.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 4: SHIP
sections.content:
**Desc:** Run `scripts/update_llms.sh` to sync the manifest to `llms.txt`.
**Result:** Your new poster is now discoverable by other AI agents.

sections.title: 🛡️ GUARDRAILS & TESTS
sections.content: **Validation:** Never hardcode content in `.typ` files. The 'Factory' must remain generic. Always verify your changes with `typst compile main.typ` to ensure the vector logic holds.

sections.title: 🚨 INCIDENT REPORT
sections.content:
**What Happened:** Font warnings broke the clean aesthetic.
**The Root Cause:** Variable fonts or unknown 'serif' string in `template.typ`.
**The Fix:** Use static versions of DejaVu Sans/Serif.
**Prevention:** Run `typst fonts` to see what is actually installed.

sections.title: 🔭 NEXT STEPS
sections.content:
**Future Learning:** Explore `assets/themes/` to implement dynamic theme loading.
**Links:** Official repo at `github.com/abuhafi/posterMaker`.
